name: XYZD
description: XYZD is building low-cost automated trading infrastructure for retail traders across onchain markets.
longDescription:
XYZD is building an automated trading and execution layer that makes advanced onchain trading strategies accessible to retail users.

Today, our core products include automated Market Making (MM) and Delta-Neutral (DN) strategies across multiple perpetual DEXs. Our infrastructure is designed to automate execution, manage positions, reduce the operational complexity of running trading strategies, and allow users to participate across different markets without manually managing every trade.

But MM and DN are only the starting point.

We are expanding XYZD into a broader agentic trading platform with autonomous trading agents, copy trading, cross-DEX strategies, and other automated trading applications. The goal is to let users access sophisticated trading workflows through simple products rather than having to build and operate their own infrastructure.

We have already processed more than $500M in trading volume across supported venues, giving us real-world experience operating automated strategies at scale.

Lighter has been an important part of that journey. Through XYZD, users have generated more than $58M in volume on Lighter’s Robinhood-chain deployment. Beyond generating volume, we are building tooling that can help bring active retail traders to Lighter, automate their trading workflows, and keep them engaged with the ecosystem.
